## Summary

I investigated ticket T-4008 and escalated it to the engineering team. The issue is that after upgrading the ingress-nginx controller to v1.12.1 over the weekend, regex-based redirects for the legacy portal are returning 404 errors instead of redirecting properly. The ingress controller and legacy-portal pods are both healthy, but the redirect behavior changed.

The problem likely stems from breaking changes in how the v1.12.1 controller handles complex regex-based rewrite rules. This requires careful engineering review to determine whether to:
- Refactor the redirect rules to work with the new controller version
- Modify controller configuration  
- Potentially revert the upgrade

Escalating ensures the fix is applied safely without breaking other service routes.
